authority: Petite Borne platform + individual site operators

evidence.finding: Each owner explicitly chooses its own billing model and tariff: per kWh, per hour, or fixed session amount; customer sells charging in its own name.
Petite Borne publishes current static + dynamic IRVE data; dataset updated 2026-09-11.
Current declared site tariffs differ (e.g. 0.36 and 0.40 EUR/kWh), confirming no uniform CPO-wide tariff.

decision: active->setAside; platform pricing is deterministically site-owner-configurable and current sites carry different prices. No national tariff extrapolation; exact station/EVSE tariff must come from current site declaration/QR.
tariffPolicy: For V9, use exact current station/EVSE direct declaration where mapped; otherwise fallback Electra then Electroverse.
